title: Minibuffer cancellation and transient argument context

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: Prompt cancellation and transient suffix execution are interaction states, not ordinary function calls.
hypothesis: A batch minibuffer can be canceled and observed as a quit; transient source can be loaded and its command-context requirement recorded, but real transient keymaps require a terminal-frame probe.
minimal_fixture: One minibuffer setup hook that aborts recursive edit; transient source availability check.
predicted_behavior: The minibuffer cancellation is observable as a quit. Transient terminal-key lifecycle is not fully exercised in batch.

independent_checks.name: transient package source is available for terminal follow-up

counterexample: Treating every prompt as a direct function call cannot model cancellation and continuation.
derived_gym_requirement: Bridge observations must expose active minibuffer/transient state, and terminal-path probes must cover transient prefix/infix/suffix lifetimes before those actions are benchmarked.
